recipe_version.title: Spanish Potato Tortilla
recipe_version.description: Yukon Gold potatoes and onion shallow-fried in olive oil, folded into egg, and set in a skillet. No cheese and no chorizo.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: enough for a shallow layer in a 10-inch skillet; most is drained off and can be saved; 2 tbsp goes back into the skillet

steps.title: Slice
steps.body: Slice the potatoes into thin rounds and the onion thin. About 15 minutes.

steps.title: Shallow-fry the potatoes
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium. Add the potatoes and onion, keep them in a shallow layer of oil, and cook, turning gently, until the potatoes are tender but not browned hard, about 18 minutes. Salt them with 1 tsp as they cook. Drain, and reserve the oil.

steps.title: Set and flip
steps.body: Beat the eggs with 1/2 tsp salt and the pepper. Fold in the potatoes and onion. Return 2 tbsp of the oil to the skillet over medium-low. Pour in the eggs and cook until the edge is set and the top is still moist, about 8 minutes. Invert onto a plate, slide it back, and cook about 4 minutes more, until the center is just firm. Cook is 30 minutes. Scatter the parsley and cut into wedges.
